column1: # 文本層的共用翻譯：`<原文>\t<譯文>`。
# 42 個地圖區塊**各自帶一份**戰鬥動詞與開門訊息，同樣的英文在 1,571 個 key 裡
# 重複出現。逐 key 翻譯只會讓同一句話被翻出好幾種版本，所以這一層按**文本**翻，
# 由 tools/build_lang.py 套到所有還沒被逐 key 翻到的相同原文上。
# 逐 key 的翻譯**永遠優先**——同一句話在某個區塊真的需要不同譯法時，
# 在那個區塊的檔案裡寫一行就會蓋過這裡。
# ⚠ 這裡**不放**單一字母、數字、與全大寫的關鍵字（Y／N／A／CHAT／MAYOR／
# FINSTER／UGLY…）。那些是玩家要輸入或選取的詞，翻掉就對不上了
# （密語的比對程式碼還沒逆向，`docs/re/33` §4）。

column1: \x0DThe door resists your attempt to open it.\x0D
\x0DThe door defies your best efforts to open it.\x0D
column2: \x0D你使盡全力，門依然不為所動。\x0D

column1: \x0DYour attempt at opening the door, however humble it may have been, is successful.\x0D
column2: \x0D你開門的嘗試雖然不怎麼樣，倒是成功了。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe door slides up into the ceiling.\x0D
\x0DThis door is sealed like a vault.\x0D
\x0DThe door has no handle or sign on it, just a narrow slot on the right side.\x0D
column2: \x0D門上沒有把手也沒有標示，只有右側一道細窄的插槽。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe door blocking your path is stout and constructed of thick wood bound by iron. It is locked.\x0D
column2: \x0D擋路的門厚實堅固，厚木板外包著鐵條。門鎖著。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe badly battered remnants of a door sag against the wall.\x0D
column2: \x0D一扇被砸爛的門殘骸靠在牆上。\x0D

column1: \x0DSplinters and fragments of wood hanging upon fireblack hinges are all that remain of the door that once was here.\x0D
column2: \x0D燻黑的鉸鏈上掛著碎裂的木片，那是這裡曾有一扇門的全部痕跡。\x0D

column1: \x0DYou don't even make a dent in the wall.\x0D
column2: \x0D你連牆上的一個凹痕都弄不出來。\x0D

column1: \x0DThese walls are more rubble than solid walls, but they still impede your progress.\x0D
column2: \x0D這些牆與其說是牆，不如說是瓦礫堆，但還是擋住了你。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe crumbling brick walls are still quite strong.\x0D
\x0DThe concrete here was poured long ago but it is still durable and solid.\x0D
column2: \x0D這裡的混凝土是很久以前灌的，但依舊耐用結實。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe cinderblocks used to build the walls are old and broken, but they still hold up the city above.\x0D
column2: \x0D砌牆用的煤渣磚又老又破，卻仍撐著上頭整座城市。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe walls are too slippery for a firm handhold.\x0D
\x0DA deadfall trap is sprung as you pass through!\x0D
column2: \x0D你穿過去的瞬間，落石陷阱觸發了！\x0D

column1: \x0DBefore you is a torpid river of raw sewage from the city of Vegas above you.\x0D
column2: \x0D你面前是一條遲滯的污水河，來自上方的維加斯城。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe sewers are dank and moist and stinking. The stench is cloying and hangs on you like wet clothing.\x0D
column2: \x0D下水道又濕又悶又臭。那股惡臭黏膩得像濕衣服一樣掛在你身上。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe solitary sound of water drops falling into puddles mocks your slow progress.\x0D
column2: \x0D水滴落進積水的單調聲響，嘲笑著你緩慢的腳步。\x0D

column1: \x0DA cool breeze sweeps silently through the blackness and chills you to the bone.\x0D
column2: \x0D一陣涼風無聲地掃過黑暗，寒意直透骨髓。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe current, though slow, is fairly strong.\x0D
\x0DDespite the sucking current, you keep your feet and move through the water easily.\x0D
column2: \x0D儘管暗流拉扯，你仍站得穩，輕鬆涉水而過。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe stream bed shifts beneath you but the rope keeps you up. You feel creatures slither between your legs.\x0D
column2: \x0D河床在腳下鬆動，繩子撐住了你。你感覺到有東西從腿間滑過。\x0D

column1: \x0DThe rope catches on debris across the stream and holds solidly. It will make your passage safer.\x0D
column2: \x0D繩子勾住對岸的碎石，牢牢固定。有它渡河會安全些。\x0D

column1: \x0DSluggish water swirls around your legs. It stinks and is slippery, but the rope helps you wade across.\x0D
column2: \x0D滯緩的水在腿邊打轉，又臭又滑，但有繩子幫忙你涉了過去。\x0D

column1: \x0DThese cute little yellow spiders don't look dangerous at all.\x0D
column2: \x0D這些可愛的小黃蜘蛛看起來一點也不危險。\x0D

column1: Roaring out a war cry, cyborgs attack from ambush.\x0D
column2: 改造人吼出戰嚎，從埋伏處撲出。\x0D

column1: Three foot tall black rats race toward you with gleaming eyes and razor-sharp teeth.\x0D
column2: 三呎高的黑鼠瞪著發亮的眼睛、露出刀刃般的牙齒衝了過來。\x0D

column1: A mutant cyborg prepares to zap you.\x0D
column2: 一個變種改造人準備電你。\x0D

column1: A metal rustling echoes from the darkness.\x0D
column2: 黑暗中傳來金屬摩擦的回聲。\x0D

column1: A solitary figure made of tungsten fibers and armor plates laughs hauntingly and shoots at you.\x0D
column2: 一個由鎢纖維與裝甲板構成的身影發出陰森的笑聲，朝你開火。\x0D

column1: A small, six-armed robot with a squat, humanoid head on top whirls in your direction and raises its weapons.\x0D
column2: 一個矮胖人形頭顱、六隻手臂的小型機器人轉向你，舉起武器。\x0D

column1: A silvery mountain of reptilian terror cocks its head, studies you for a moment, then attacks!\x0D
column2: 一座銀色的爬蟲惡夢歪了歪頭，端詳你片刻，然後撲了上來！\x0D

column1: Please help me get out of here.\x0D
